material.acceptance_criteria: A hero whose state is dead shows no positive hp in the team strip.
material.description: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:194-196 update_heroes sets state 'dead' without updating hp, and team_tree at panels.lua:318 prints that stale h.hp beside the 'dead' label. The state and the hp reading can disagree, so a dead row shows a positive hp.
material.subject: Dead hero's team-strip hp keeps the last live reading
material.witness: Premise absent on the working tree (codesearch dispatch 1792862296046-5410-5b95f2559b52bfe0, session verify-ILLEGAL-trav-hud-lua-L1-3): team_tree (panels.lua:279-292) prints kills and the clock only, no hp. hp occurs at 193 (update_heroes writes HEROES), 223-231 (hud_tree: alive primary only) and 442-473 (select_tree: alive selection only). HEROES is read by no render; it is reset at 633. The stale team-strip hp cannot be shown, so a dead row cannot show a positive hp.
material.witness_plan: Live match: a hero dies while the team rows are expanded; its hp cell must no longer show the pre-death value.
